info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Guideline Compliance Check API
info.description: The Guideline Compliance Check API enables users to assess the compliance status of banking operations against established guidelines. This endpoint allows consumers, such as compliance officers and risk management teams, to retrieve detailed information on specific guidelines by providing the relevant parameter. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and enhance operational integrity. It is an essential tool for maintaining compliance and mitigating risks in the banking sector.

get.summary: Retrieve compliance details for a specific guideline
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch compliance details related to guideline RES-100045. It returns relevant information that helps in understanding the compliance status and requirements associated with this guideline.
